title: Euclid Oddities: pre-registered tests of an LLM anomaly inspector in Euclid DR1, with a public gallery of unverified finds
description:
Pre-registrations (with SHA-256 hashes), amendments, reports and null results from an open-ended search of ESA Euclid DR1 (public since 12 November 2026) with Claude. Track D tests whether vision-language models (Claude Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.2) can flag unusual objects in Euclid cutouts, using planted fakes under a sealed key, unlabelled known lenses and thresholds fixed in advance. A larger 2x2 view raised Fable 5.2's recall of planted oddities from 9/24 to 14/24 with 3/16 false features. Flags on fresh sky were cross-matched with SIMBAD, NED and ECLIPSE and given blind second opinions by Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.2 and OpenAI GPT-6 Astra. Track A tests a one-versus-two point-source fit for sub-arcsecond lensed quasars. Failures and sensitivities are reported in full. Nothing here is a confirmed discovery.

Gallery of every flagged object: spacesim.co/euclid-oddities, part of SpaceSim, a free browser universe simulator.
